title: Month 6 Day 21

items.label: The Jubilee Cycle & the Abominaition of Desolation

notes:
This teaching covers the seventh-year Sabbath cycle and the Year of Jubilee—the release of debts and servants, the apostles as willing bond-servants of Yeshua, Israel’s failure to keep the land Sabbaths, and the 70-year Babylonian captivity. It then connects the Jubilee cycle to Yeshua’s ministry and the timeline leading toward 70 AD. The second portion examines Josephus, Nero’s persecution, and the Jewish-Roman War, linking Yeshua’s words in Luke 21, Mark 13, and Matthew 24 to the siege of Jerusalem and the Abomination of Desolation. It concludes in Revelation 16–18 with the woman and the beast, Jerusalem as the great city, and the avenging of the blood of the saints.
